report_name: Technical University of Denmark Breach Exposes Data of 200,000

threat_actors.name: DTUBasen Compromise Actor
threat_actors.description: Unidentified actors responsible for the data breach at the Technical University of Denmark by compromising the DTUBasen identity management system and exfiltrating data on 200,000 users.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Attackers compromised user profiles to gain initial access to the DTUBasen identity management system.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: Attackers accessed and exfiltrated a large dataset of user information from DTUBasen, the university's central identity management system, which served as a user information repository.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated a large volume of sensitive user data, including CPR numbers, after accessing the DTUBasen database.

identities.name: Technical University of Denmark
identities.description: A Danish university that suffered a major data breach of its central identity management system, DTUBasen, exposing the data of 200,000 individuals.

indicators.name: Suspicious Bulk User Data Query
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Bulk User Data Query
id: 2b1a8c3d-5e7f-4b9a-8c1d-6f5e4d3c2b1a
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious database queries attempting to select all records from a user table, which could indicate data exfiltration preparation as seen in the DTU breach.
references:
  - https://www.dtu.dk/english/newsarchive/2026/10/cyberattack-on-dtu_notification-of-a-personal-data-breach
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-04
tags:
  - attack.t1213
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: application
detection:
  selection:
    Message|contains: 'SELECT * FROM users'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects suspicious database queries attempting to select all records from a user table, which could indicate data exfiltration preparation as seen in the DTU breach.
